text: I cannot confirm there were *no* thermal detections for the *full* period. While NASA FIRMS data (MODIS and VIIRS sensors) showed no detections for most of the time (13 Oct–6 Nov and 12 Nov), there is a 4-day gap (2–6 Nov) where VIIRS_SNPP data was unavailable. During this gap, thermal activity *could* have occurred but would not be detectable in this dataset. Thus, the evidence is insufficient to rule out thermal activity entirely.
